title: 5/08-09 inline shadow generation ran without watchdog pings and re-ran after restarts: scheduler restart loop; shadow disabled on the box
tier_reason: liveness of the production scheduler (a restart loop driven by the in-process shadow run) required a production config mitigation; the shadow stream lost the 5/09 record

contract.text: Every long RUNNING-state operation inside the scheduler (including the shadow prediction) keeps the heartbeat and the systemd watchdog fed, and a restart does not redo work whose artifact already exists.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md at 4bd8193 'Heartbeat-watchdog discipline'; commit 150ed4c message body

mechanism.text: _run_shadow_prediction called predict_local_shadow (feature computation plus shadow blend) inside the scheduler with no heartbeat_watchdog, so a long shadow run left the systemd watchdog unfed
the shadow step did not skip a date whose shadow artifact was already written, so after any restart it ran again, re-entering the unfed long run - the restart loop 'after successful writes'

residual.text: Inline shadow still shared the scheduler process and memory; it was moved to its own unit by 43ddf0c (5/22) after the OOM indications of E52 (I-052).

watchdog.trigger: three or more scheduler restarts within 60 minutes, or a watchdog/SIGABRT exit, while a shadow run is recorded in progress for a date whose shadow artifact already exists
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the day's shadow artifact is written once and NRestarts stays flat through the shadow run

evidence.locator: commit 150ed4c message body (PR #66; same change as f8c9b41)
evidence.what: wraps shadow model generation in heartbeat/watchdog pings and skips existing daily shadow artifacts 'to avoid restart loops after successful writes'
